patternCategory: Small Cap Short First Red Day (SC FRD)

dailyNotes: Steady downtrend with pre-market (PM) pops that get sold usually to offer shares, raise capital, which will increase the share count making it a dilutive agenda
volumeNotes: Day 2 (D2) had slightly more volume, majority was on the open & looked to be shorts covering who were holding overnight, or organic buyers that believed the stock was heading higher, but ultimately the company ended up taking advantage of the volume & offering new shares to the market

intradayNotes: Was strong all day with minor pullbacks, news Tom Lee was taking the company over with intentions to create an Ethereum Digital Asset Treasury Company (DAT), excitement over Microstrategy & cryptocurrency companies was still everywhere, perfect storm for a long with misinformed shorts & a lot of exuberance in the air still, bought later in the day after a pullback from 30 to 25 with risk at 20, scaled out of the rest at 42 & 50 in the after hours (AH)
dailyNotes: Daily was flat for almost a year, became a candidate for takeover to turn into a DAT & when that happened, the capital structure changed completely & the company turns into something new, it's important to understand how a company has acted in the past, but it's just as important to see what a company is becoming
volumeNotes: Strong consistent volume all day, slowly dropping volume throughout the day but more than normal for end of day (EOD)

patternCategory: Large Cap First Red Day (LC FRD)
intradayNotes: Entered short after the swipe up above pre-market high (PMH) at 130 with risk at high of day (HOD) at 138, started working so added at 126 & 124 with new risk at 132, covered half on the flush to 118 & 115, re-entered on the pop to 121 & 122 with risk at 126, started working so added at 115, covered 50% at 112 & the other half at 110.50, clean fade after 2 days of gapping up after it's highly anticipated IPO
dailyNotes: IPO 2 days prior, gapping up each prior day & increasing volume, with this day having some buying on the open, but mostly selling, prior two sessions were unusually strong & ripe for large buyers to take advantage of the volume & become sellers
volumeNotes: Some buying on the open, turned into a false breakout candle above pre-market high (PMH) with no follow through to the upside, heavy selling started coming in after it started to show weakness after the open, volume slowed down for the first hour of the day, but more selling volume came in once the stock showed signs of not going any higher for the day

intradayNotes: Entered short at 58 on the opening swipe up over pre-market high (PMH) with risk being high of day (HOD) at 62, covered 50% on the flush to 45, added on pops to 55 with risk at 58, got stopped then re-entered higher at 72 with risk being 74, started working so added at 64, 63 & 62 with new risk at 68, added on the breakdown of 60 with risk being at 67, added on a few more breakdowns from 60 to 50 with risk ending up at 62, covered half at 47 & remaining half at 45
dailyNotes: Big gap up yesterday, went higher the whole sessions & took that long, then waited for exhaustion the next day after another gap up pre-market (PM)
volumeNotes: Volume was strong on the open, then dried up later in the session, made a new high of day (HOD) a few times but on lower volume each time, which is signs of exhaustion

intradayNotes: Was weak on the open, entered short at 3.40 with risk being at 3.65, got stopped & re-entered over pre-market high (PMH) at 3.80 with risk at 4.10, got stopped & re-entered one last time at 4.30 with risk at 4.50, started working so added at 3.90 with risk at 4.35. added on a pop at 4 with risk at 4.25, added one more time at 3.35 on the flush from 4 to 3.20 with new risk in the money (ITM) at 3.80, got stopped at 3.80 at 15:00 so trade was done for the day
dailyNotes: One other time the stock ran from 0.60 to 2.75 & had one day flush from 2.50 to 1.25, thought similar action would happen but didn't work out the way I planned, had more swipe ups & jams than I anticipated & volume was not consistent with other similar setups
volumeNotes: Volume was increasing as it made new highs, usually not signs of exhaustion but heavier selling came in for the big flush from 4 to 3.20, should have been covering there instead of adding, while looking to re-enter higher if the opportunity presented itself

patternCategory: Small Cap Short First Red Day (SC FRD)
intradayNotes: Entered short on the open at 40 with risk at 45, added on the break of 40 with risk at 43, added on the breakdown of 39 with risk at high of day (HOD) at 41, added on a few breakdowns for the rest of the day with risk ending up at 37 which was in the money (ITM), anticipating an offering with the new S-1 that they filed & was ready to go, ended up offering at $30 in the after hours (AH) & covered all shares where I could from 30.50 to 27.75
dailyNotes: Daily was over-extended with signs of exhaustion, missed the First Red Day set up from 120 to 70, stock still looked weak even with the recent flush from 160 to 40 over the prior weeks
volumeNotes: Once the S-1 was registered, I anticipated them offering relatively soon, even with the stock being much higher recently, registered filings signal the company will take advantage of the new volume to offer new shares to the market sooner than later, which is dilutive & mostly done at discount to current market prices

patternCategory: Large Cap First Red Day (LC FRD)
intradayNotes: Entered short on a push above pre-market high (PMH) at 3.30 with risk at 3.60, started working so added at 3.15 with risk at 3.50, got stopped at 3.50 & re-entered higher at 3.60 with risk at 3.80, got stopped at 3.80 & didn't like how it was trading with volume staying consistent so didn't trade it again for the rest of the day, ended up climbing to 4.95 by 14:45, then violently flushed to 2.80 by 15:30
dailyNotes: Stock mostly in a steady downtrend on the daily chart, started moving on excitement from Twitter (Now named 'X') & went from 0.50 to 2.25 over two weeks, then gapped up from 2 to 3, no dilutionary agenda in place
volumeNotes: Rising volume over the weeks on the daily chart with consistent volume through the day, lots of selling volume coming in end of day (EOD) with the big flush from 4.95 to 2.80

patternCategory: Large Cap First Red Day Continued (LC FRD CONT)
intradayNotes: Gapped up again, so entered short on the open at 3.70 with risk at pre-market high (PMH) at 4.00, started working so added at 3.50 with risk now at 3.80, covered half on the flush from 3.25 to 2.85, re-entered higher on the pop to volume weighted average price (VWAP) at 3.30 with risk at 3.70, final add at 3.10 with risk being at 3.70, final covers for remaining shares at 2.85 & 2.95
dailyNotes: Over-extended daily chart with prior session gapping up, with todays session gaping up on less volume, went from 0.50 to 4.95 in two weeks, with two days gapping up in pre-market (PM) in a row
volumeNotes: Gapped up two days in a row, with less volume the next day, lots of selling volume on the open on the second gap up, but volume dried up the rest of the day with bursts of selling mostly at the end of the day

patternCategory: Large Cap First Red Day Continued (LC FRD CONT)
intradayNotes: Waited for a pop above pre-market high (PMH) & up closer to the prior days low to enter, entered at 2.85 with risk at 3.00, started working so added at 2.65 with new risk at high of day (HOD) at 2.90, added again at 2.60 & 2.53 with risk being at 2.65, should have been covering into the end of day (EOD) flushes near low of day (LOD)
dailyNotes: Ran from 0.50 to 4.95 over two weeks, gapped down day prior, gapped up this session on low volume so signs of exhaustion were apparent
volumeNotes: Gapped up on almost two billion shares of volume three days prior, with decreasing volume every day after making the high at 4.95

intradayNotes: Strong pre-market so entered long around 60 with risk being 50, started to work on the open so added up to 68 with new risk being 55, took advantage of the heavy buying volume & sold from 75 to 85, but should have raised my stop & held for a bigger move, missed out on potentially a 50 to 60 point move
dailyNotes: Had two strong gap up days, with no signs of slowing down, rising on lower volume on the daily, hot market theme with plenty of people wanting to speculate the name would go higher
volumeNotes: Consistent volume all day, mostly buyers & minimal selling came in through end of day (EOD), mostly stayed flat from 12:00 to 16:00

intradayNotes: Stock was running on news of a new fifty million dollar equity line to accelerate AI-Driven defense, which was two hot themes at the time, usually the stock would get sold off on that news, but the fact it stayed strong over two days signaled the stock was stronger than anticipated, entered at 6.50 with risk at 5.50, no adds & scaled out from 9.25 to 10.75
dailyNotes: News of equity line came out two days prior & the stock ran from 2.50 to 13, gapped down the day after the news, but held the line with no direction in a tight range
volumeNotes: Big volume on Day 1 (D1) of the move, much lighter volume on Day 2 (D2) with more buying volume coming in on the open on day 3 of the move, but dried up after 12:30 & gave back most of the gains for the rest of the day

intradayNotes: Entered short on the swipe above pre-market high (PMH) at 6.50 with risk at 7.00, got stopped at 7.00 & re-entered on the flush back towards 6.50, risk at 7.00, started working so added at 5.80 with risk at 6.50, lowered stop to 5.50 without adding through the day & covered between 4.75 & 4.25
dailyNotes: Was a special purpose acquisition vehicle (SPAC) that came from 10, dropped to 1, gapped up on Day 1 (D1) of the move from 0.50 to 1.20 & ran the rest of the day to 4.90, then gapped up again the next day on lower volume
volumeNotes: Gapped up on lower volume for Day 2 (D2) of the move, making new highs after the open on lower volume then increasing selling volume after 10:00, from 7.15 to 4.25 by 11:30 & traded in a range from 4.25 to 4.90 the rest of the day

patternCategory: Small Cap Short First Red Day (SC FRD)
intradayNotes: Was strong on the open at 57, entered short at 57 with risk at 60, got stopped at 60, re-entered higher at 62 with risk at 66, got stopped, re-entered one for a final attempt at 63 on a flush & what looked to be a false breakout candle, with risk at 67, but got stopped & didn't trade it the rest of the day
dailyNotes: Ran from 5 to 160, came back down to 30 where they offered new shares, then started gaining volume again & went from 30 to 70, gapped up another two days in a row, thought this would be a good SC FRD setup, but was volatile up & down all day
volumeNotes: Volatile on both sides up & down, lots of volume trading on the day but mostly on the open, with the name making new highs on lower volume around 11:30, then dropping with slightly more volume at 12:30 & ending the day around where it started around 58

intradayNotes: Entered long after the open at 4.25 with risk at low of day (LOD) at 3.50, after a gap up from 2.00 to 3.50 on news of private investment in public equity (PIPE) offering, was working so added a few times at 5.50, 7.50 & 12, selling some at 5.25, 12.50, 13 & 15, sold remaining shares at 13
dailyNotes: Was running on earnings report & a PIPE offering, which are always an avoid for short entries, but can give the market confidence they've raised cash & those shares won't be sold on the open market until a later date
volumeNotes: Big volume on Day 1 (D1) & came in heavier through 11:30, even with lighter volume through end of day (EOD) it made a final high of day (HOD) at 14:15 around 17.50
